full_name: Valentina Rozas-Krause | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Humanities Frieda L. Miller Fellow Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez (Chile)
bio: An assistant professor in design and architecture at Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez, Valentina Rozas-Krause is an architect and a historian of the built environment who focuses on global cultural practices across the Americas and Europe.
